## `neuro.date.setMonth`

Instance method on `Date.prototype`.

> Sets the month value in the Date object using local time.

## Signatures

```ts
setMonth(input: { date: <receiver>; month: number; date_arg?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.prototype.setMonth` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
